The '''GL-11''' was a handheld [[Grenade launcher/Legends|grenade launcher]] that was designed to work with the [[Merr-Sonn Munitions, Inc./Legends|Merr-Sonn]] family of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]]. It featured a [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] [[Stock/Legends|stock]] with a chopped launcher [[Barrel/Legends|barrel]]. The GL-11 fired [[C-16 fragmentation grenade]]s, while the GL-11s fired [[C-10 stun grenade/Legends|C-10 stun grenades]].
